WHAT WE DO

A specialist partner,
never a CV agency.

We know that every career move or leadership hire is more than a transaction. That is why we take the time to listen, map regional markets discreetly, and advise both clients and candidates in electrical wholesale, technical distribution, construction and engineering.

With deep networks across UK technical industry, we deliver the search rigour of an international executive firm alongside the personal accountability of a dedicated specialist working exclusively for one organisation per sector at a time.

Where agreed, we connect that appointment to workplace coaching and seven human-controlled business platforms so new hires and branch teams sustain margin, follow-up speed and clear customer ownership.

OUR METHODOLOGY

Our Approach: The Hybrid Advantage.

We blend direct human headhunting judgement with transparent market research, coaching habits and seven practical software workflows.

01 / DISCOVERY & STRATEGY

Commercial Role Blueprint

We partner with directors up front to define what the person must achieve in the branch or division before approaching passive competitor talent.

  • Clear scope & P&L objectives
  • Named competitor boundaries
02 / PASSIVE MAPPING

Discreet Direct Headhunting

Using structured market mapping and human networks, we identify and confidentially approach proven performers who do not apply to job boards.

  • NDA-protected outreach
  • One organisation per sector
03 / COACHING & 7 PLATFORMS

Commercial Habits & Tools

Reinforce appointments with six practical coaching programmes and our seven B2B platforms (Market/Prospect Intelligence, CRM, Comms, Delivery, Automation & Marketing).

  • Quote follow-up & margin discipline
  • Human-reviewed evidence & handovers
04 / WRITTEN EXCLUSIVITY

Zero Conflict of Interest

Where single-client exclusivity is agreed in writing for your mandate, we block out named direct competitors across the agreed territory and timeframe.

  • Written scope & competitors
  • Dedicated partner accountability

WHY HEADHUNTING, COACHING & PLATFORMS SIT TOGETHER

One joined-up approach
to commercial growth.

Each pillar solves a distinct commercial problem, and they reinforce one another when connected around your business.

01 / HEADHUNTING (CORE SERVICE)

Secure the right people

We work with one organisation per sector at a time to appoint leadership, branch managers and technical sales specialists.

  • Commercial brief agreed before mapping starts
  • Discreet approach to proven passive performers
  • Structured assessment against real job requirements
02 / COACHING & DEVELOPMENT

Build consistent everyday habits

Appointing a leader is only step one. Practical coaching builds discovery, quote follow-up and margin habits across the team.

  • Workshops tied to live branch accounts and quotes
  • Clear weekly operating rhythms for branch managers
  • Trackable operational indicators agreed up front
03 / AI & BUSINESS SERVICES (7 PLATFORMS)

Give teams clear ownership & visibility

Seven platforms give staff public UK market intel, human-reviewed prospect evidence, CRM separation, enquiries, delivery handovers and campaign reporting.

  • Human-reviewed workflows & operator handover.js runs
  • Separate Business CRM and Personal CRM boundaries
  • Honest distinction between pilots and planned tools

HOW WE OPERATE

Clear standards.
Human judgement first.

The principles governing every headhunting mandate, coaching sprint and platform walkthrough.

01 / COMMERCIAL CLARITY

Direct, honest advice

We state clearly what a candidate has delivered, what a coaching sprint tracks, and which software capabilities run in demos/pilots versus planned roadmaps.

02 / HUMAN IN CONTROL

Technology supports; people decide

Prospect evidence acceptance, extractive AI Team briefs, and Sales-to-Delivery handovers remain under explicit human sign-off.

03 / SECTOR EXCLUSIVITY

Defined in writing

We sign bilateral NDAs, protect candidate discretion and define single-client sector exclusivity in written agreements.
